interactions.title: Candrosa leads the funeral
lines: DM: As Candrosa begins to speak to the gathered crowd, offering a prayer to Sonkar to ease the passage of the dead and judge their souls worthy of rest, you can hear the quiver of doubt and fear in his voice. Yet as he keeps talking about the two acolytes who died, speaking of their lives, their hopes and joys, and offering prayers of remembrance and healing—a farewell to the mortal body—his voice regains some confidence and vigor and, as he begins the prayer to Shakun to hold the community together, whether by some aftereffect of the ritual visions you experienced or some newfound sense you've acquired, you can see this glowing web of energy among the people stretch and pulse with the moonlight, although, as you watch, there's nowhere for this energy to go. The center is still dark and absent. And as you're drawn into this vision, you can see some breaks in this web as well, six places where the webs of power are matte gray, not silver, where tendrils of energy break off and drain from the web of interconnections into nothingness. As Candrosa finishes his prayer, this vision fades and the funeral service concludes.

A small crowd has gathered as the news of the shadow attacks and its consequences have spread and the funeral pyres are already being prepared. As the community of the Shakun Mystai gather, you can still faintly see the echoes of the web of power that stretches among them, thinking back to the events of the past 24 hours. Starting with the stories that Candrosa told: the Heart of Shakun, an artifact central to the magical defenses of the Dunmari. Cintra, the Supreme Oracle of the Mystai, one in whom the goddess herself seems to dwell, who had a young daughter who took sick and could not be cured by ordinary magic. Cintra's decision to take the Heart of Shakun south to Shakun's Wellspring beyond the edge of the mesa which dreams and visions had told would cure her daughter. The Mystai of Shakun traveling to find Cintra after her too-long absence, but none returning. Candrosa remaining silent out of doubt or fear, uncertainty about the consequences of breaking the secret bonds of the Mystai. And turning in the face of this challenge until the guilt and the burden were too much. And he spoke with you.
